lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: Up the river, past the wheel, to the falls. There's a hollow in the rocks at the bottom.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: They go in at dawn. I hear them.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: Forty grosze. I'd say more. The wheel's been frozen two winters, I grind by hand what people bring, and nobody brings anything.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: Mind the bank. The ice over the race is bad.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest; flat question, not rising

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: She's dead? The one with the scar?
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest; flat question, not rising

lines.speaker: miller
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest; after a held beat; short, quiet

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: I'll let the boy down to the river tomorrow. Not today.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest; short, quiet

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: My father never let anyone fish there. Warm water comes up. The ice is never as thick as it looks.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: You put your hand in the hole there and it isn't cold like the other holes. My father did it, his father did it.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: The old ones know. Most of them are dead.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: There's soup, if you want. My wife made it.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.text: The boy's been down to the river twice. He took the dog's bowl with him.
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller
lines.direction: plain, anxious, honest

lines.speaker: miller_wife
lines.text: Wipe your feet. I've just done it.
lines.direction: short and worried, then easier

lines.speaker: miller_wife
lines.text: He did. He won't say it, but he hasn't slept.
lines.direction: short and worried, then easier

lines.speaker: miller_wife
lines.text: Inside. They've been inside for six days. They fight.
lines.direction: short and worried, then easier

lines.speaker: miller_wife
lines.text: Kill them, and you can have whatever is in the pot.
lines.direction: short and worried, then easier

lines.speaker: miller_wife
lines.direction: short and worried, then easier

lines.speaker: miller_wife
lines.text: I let them out into the yard this morning. They came back in covered in snow and I could have kissed them.
lines.direction: short and worried, then easier

lines.speaker: miller_wife
lines.text: There's soup. It's turnip, I'm sorry. It was turnip yesterday.
lines.direction: short and worried, then easier
